_readme: Entry point for any new session on Cosmos. Read this, then manifests/roadmap.json, then the newest manifests/session-NN.json, then WIP.md. README.md explains the layout and how to add things.
status_in_one_line: Map, gravity sandbox and 3D orbit puzzles (10 levels, endless, and a huge galaxy playground whose discovered stars are saved) are built and tested. Needs one restart inside Forge for galaxy saves. The shooter, visualizer, PulseForge scenes, the 3D flight sim and the Gaia layer are planned in the roadmap.

modes.flight: roadmap sessions 6 to 9 (3D Kerbal-style; core/nbody3d.js can be reused)

how_to_check.javascript: node --test tests/js/   (COSMOS_LEVELGEN_SEEDS=N changes the generator sweep; COSMOS_LEVEL_DIR points the level tests elsewhere)
how_to_check.browser: Scratch server on a free port, then flatpak run --command=/app/extra/google-chrome com.google.Chrome --headless=new --use-angle=swiftshader --enable-unsafe-swiftshader --no-sandbox --virtual-time-budget=7000 --window-size=1400,900 --screenshot=OUT 'http://127.0.0.1:PORT/?pz=LEVEL#puzzles'. --disable-gpu gives a black 3D canvas. Adding &pzfire=1 saves a real result to puzzle-progress.json.
how_to_check.power: RAPL needs root: sudo -S sh -c 'cat /sys/class/powercap/intel-rapl:0/energy_uj' before and after a run. Check /sys/class/powercap/intel-rapl:0:1 (graphics) first: over about 1.5 W means Jan is busy and the numbers are not comparable.
